comment: The guidance names image interpretation as an AI use case but does not identify the imaging-data and workflow foundations required for safe deployment. Generic clinical-data exchange is insufficient for large diagnostic images, imaging metadata and report-return workflows.

public.text: The guidance names image interpretation as an AI use case but does not identify the imaging-data and workflow foundations required for safe deployment. Generic clinical-data exchange is insufficient for large diagnostic images, imaging metadata and report-return workflows.
public.suggestedRevision: Add diagnostic-imaging interoperability as an explicit implementation pattern, covering DICOM and DICOMweb, PACS and RIS integration, FHIR imaging references and diagnostic reports, large-object transfer, store-and-forward operation, and continuity across facilities.
